description: Named variables of the Floatstinger's behaviour (chara/Floatstinger/behavior.lua reads and writes them by name). Each character instance owns a small block of bytes; every entry of "fields" names one value in it: "name" is the name the script uses, "kind" the storage type (s8, u8, s16, u16, s32, u32: a write keeps the low bits, a read sign- or zero-extends), "at" the byte offset in the block (absent: the next naturally aligned offset), "note" what the value means. Values are raw integers in the units the behaviour uses (usually Q12, 4096 = 1.0 or 1 m; angles Q12, 4096 = a full turn). A mod adds or changes fields with a state.json of the same path; keep the offsets of fields the behaviour already uses.

fields.name: floatstinger_flags
fields.note: 0x1 fast (hard difficulty or enraged), 0x2 enraged by heavy damage, 0x4 sting counted, 0x8 spit cooling down, 0x10 vocal of the current clip window played.

fields.name: floatstinger_turn_rate
fields.note: Turn rate (angle per second): flying turns build up and ease off.

fields.name: floatstinger_steer_angle
fields.note: The heading the flight steers along (towards the target or around Harry).

fields.name: floatstinger_stagger_damage
fields.note: Damage points since the last stagger, and since the last rage.

fields.name: floatstinger_damage_window
fields.note: Damage taken in the recent window (it drains): a burst of hits counts only up to a cap.

fields.name: floatstinger_detour_angle
fields.note: A detour heading around Harry kept for a while once found.
